extracted.name: ALMOND BUTTER COOKIE😋🍪
extracted.description: This is totally like fantasy to make cookies without oven.bcuz yes I dont recommend ovens and microwave foods. #mommasrecipes #veggies
instruction_lines: Set a flat pan at low flame and set another utensil to make cookies over it
Let it preheat for 10 minutes and start making dough
Mix and whisk well even you can use mixer.now add flour and make mixed dough.no need to knead please just mix all the ingredients by add 1 to 2 tsp milk
Rest for 10 minutes and make little balls and press fork at upper layer to make some design
Set butter sheet or not and put the cookies in pan and let it bake for 15 minutes complete
Let it cool down.cookies always so soft when it's hot but after cool down it becomes hard and good to eat.enjoy cookies
